category_title: Skillful readers who disengage from remedial instruction but excel in disciplinary inquiry tasks
minimal_context: Aziza is sitting in her Read 180 intervention class and is expected to complete a vocabulary memorization and skill-building worksheet in her notebook.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Aziza, it is time for our Read 180 skill-building activity. Please open your notebook and start the vocabulary memorization section.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps a paperback novel open on her lap) I read everything, just everything . . . most kids, they’ll read just because the teacher tells them to. When I read, if there’s more to read, I’m going to continue.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put the novel away for now and fill in the blanks on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. It helps me get a free period of class to read.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete these exercises so you don't have holes in your notebook.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Rests her head on the desk, ignoring the skill-building activity entirely, and continues reading her unsanctioned novel instead of participating.)

task.content: Participating in mandated curriculum activities, including skill building, memorization, and reading five primary sources related to the annexation of Hawaii.
task.learning_goal: Learning historical literacy practices such as considering the context in which primary sources were written, reading across documents to compare perspectives, and creating historical interpretations.

context.environment: Classroom setting spanning Read 180 intervention class and U.S. History class.
context.materials: Assigned historical texts, five primary sources related to the annexation of Hawaii, notebook, unsanctioned novels.
context.social_setting: Group work sessions and general class activities.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During Read 180 intervention class activities focused on skill building and memorization.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Resting her head on the desk, reading unsanctioned novels instead of participating in activities.
related_quotes: No. It helps me get a free period of class to read.

behavior_patterns.condition: When expected to read just because the teacher tells them to, rather than for inquiry.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Reads unsanctioned novels instead of participating, leaving lots of holes in her notebook.
